images.filename: Theatre Playbill Giselle -Moris Lekiashvili-State Academic Opera Ballet Theatre Ukrainian SSR Kyiv- 17 July.jpg
images.caption: Theatre playbill for the ballet Giselle (music by Adolphe Adam), State Academic Opera and Ballet Theatre of the Ukrainian SSR named after T.G. Shevchenko (Order of Lenin), Kyiv. Sunday 17 July. Announced as the first performance of Moris Lekiashvili (მორის ლეკიაშვილი, 1936–2024) in the role of Count Albrecht, the principal male lead. Lekiashvili was a Soviet Georgian ballet dancer, principal soloist, choreographer and pedagogue. Merited Artist of Georgia. Husband of soprano Lamara Chkonia, People's Artist of the USSR (1976). Photographed and archived by her granddaughter as part of a family legacy preservation project, 2024.
